```{r}
library(lme4)
```


nitrogen level as the main plot, management practice as the sub-plot, and rice variety as the sub-sub plot
 
```{r}
df <- agridat::gomez.splitsplit

m_mle <- 
  lmer(yield ~ factor(nitro) * factor(management) * factor(gen) +
         (1| rep / nitro / management), 
      data = df, 
      REML = F)

m_reml <- 
  lmer(yield ~ factor(nitro) * factor(management) * factor(gen) +
         (1| rep / nitro / management), 
      data = df, 
      REML = T)

glmmTMB::glmmTMB()
```

```{r}
VarCorr(m_mle)
VarCorr(m_reml)

emmeans(m_reml, ~ gen)
```
